entries.summary: Public projects created on 3 November 2026: 4 repos, 2 datasets and 2 models.
entries.intro: New repositories covered agent tooling and home network security, with three agent plugins and a playbook for keeping cheap IP cameras local-only. On Hugging Face, the new work was speech-recognition training material: a small model that writes read-aloud sentences, its training data, and a mixed English-Hebrew sentence dataset.

projects.name: ChatGPT Workspace Agents Claude Plugin
projects.description: Builds and manages ChatGPT Workspace Agents from Claude Code by driving the agent builder in a browser, since OpenAI has no public API for creating them.

projects.name: Guava Health Plugin
projects.description: Unofficial plugin and Python CLI for the Guava Health API: logs medications, symptoms and readings, and reviews the data, including for dependents on a family plan.

projects.name: IP Cam Lockdown
projects.description: Forensics and a playbook for running cheap AliExpress IP cameras local-only: how each one reaches the vendor cloud, and how to cut it off.

projects.name: Network Forensics Plugin
projects.description: Skills for tracing what a device on a home network talks to, documenting it, blocking it at the firewall and verifying the lockdown.

projects.name: English Hebrew Mixed Sentences
projects.description: English sentences with Hebrew words and phrases mixed in, for training and evaluating speech-to-text for English speakers in Israel.

projects.name: Term Context Sentences
projects.description: Training data for writing short read-aloud sentences that use a given term in a given context, covering romanized Hebrew and Yiddish, Israeli names and tech vocabulary.

projects.name: Contextual Sentence Creator
projects.description: LoRA fine-tune of Granite 4.2 3B that returns natural sentences using a given term in a given context, for recording speech-recognition training data.

projects.name: Contextual Sentence Creator GGUF
projects.description: GGUF builds of Contextual-Sentence-Creator in Q4_K_M and Q8_0, for running it with llama.cpp.

entries.summary: Public projects created on 2 November 2026: 7 repos and 1 dataset.
entries.intro: New repositories covered agent tooling and local speech work, with two agent plugins for text-to-speech and staged transcription. Other projects included a handwriting recognition model, an Android clock widget, a manual-rewriting tool, and Konsole settings for Claude Code sessions. On Hugging Face, the new dataset was one speaker reading desktop voice commands.

projects.name: Claude Konsole Setup
projects.description: Konsole settings for running Claude Code sessions: window-close protection, no single-tab prompt, split layout; apply.sh for other machines

projects.name: Daniel Handwriting Recognition
projects.description: Fine-tuning a handwriting recognition (HTR) model on Daniel's handwriting: data collection plan, ground truth, training

projects.name: Laptop Search 1126
projects.description: Laptop search, November 2026: requirements, spec notes and voice-note transcripts.

projects.name: Local TTS Plugin
projects.description: Local text-to-speech for Claude Code: Kokoro (CPU), NeuTTS Air (CPU cloning), Chatterbox (ROCm/CUDA). Installs, registers and runs local TTS models.

projects.name: Local UTC Widget
projects.description: Android home-screen widget: local time and UTC side by side, 24-hour, with optional date, UTC offset and font choice

projects.name: Transcription Pipeline
projects.description: Agent skills for transcription in stages: retrieve, preprocess (EQ, denoise, VAD), transcribe (OpenRouter/Gemini, AssemblyAI, local Whisper/Parakeet), clean, label speakers, reshape, Typst PDF, save

projects.name: Useful User Manuals
projects.description: Turn bloated product manuals into useful ones: fetch, trim to your language, rewrite, or one-task how-to PDFs, always citing the original.

projects.name: Voice Command Sentences
projects.description: One speaker reading desktop voice commands for a KDE Plasma voice-command agent: launching, switching to and closing apps (Konsole, Kate, Dolphin, Kdenlive, Audacity), browser and terminal tabs,...

entries.summary: Public projects created on 1 November 2026: 2 repos.
entries.intro: New repositories covered audio dataset preservation and mobile GitHub discovery, with a tool for archiving audio datasets into checksummed, disc-sized snapshots and an Android app for browsing topics, running advanced search operators, sorting results, and starring repos into Lists.

projects.name: Audio Dataset Backup
projects.description: Gathers Daniel's Hugging Face audio datasets into a pinned, checksummed, disc-sized point-in-time archive (M-DISC / cloud)

projects.name: GitHub Discovery
projects.description: Android app for discovering GitHub repos: browse topics, use desktop-grade advanced search operators on mobile, sort by newest or most starred, and star repos into Lists.

entries.summary: Public projects created on 31 October 2026: 4 repos and 1 dataset.
entries.intro: New repositories covered agent tooling and dictation cleanup, with an agent plugin for capturing mid-thread ideas into in-repo sprints and a catalogue of LoRA format adapters on a small dictation model. Two further repositories documented conversational AI triage and batch inference mechanics on OpenRouter. On Hugging Face, the new dataset was a reference list of OpenRouter batch-capable models with batch and sync prices.

projects.name: AI Assistant Triage
projects.description: A public notebook of quick, point-in-time triage scorecards for conversational AI tools with native agentic capabilities, looked at through one lens: how well they integrate with external tools (MCP...

projects.name: Dictation Format Adapters
projects.description: Bounded catalogue of LoRA format adapters (shopping list, emails, blog outline, calendar JSON) on a 0.6B dictation cleanup model

projects.name: Flow Control
projects.description: Stay in flow: capture and triage mid-thread ideas, requests and bugs into in-repo sprints and backlog, then carry on. Agent skills.

projects.name: OpenRouter Batch Notes
projects.description: Research notebook on batch inference via OpenRouter: Batch API mechanics, batch vs sync pricing, traps. Written by Claude Opus 5.5, 2026-10-31.

projects.name: OR Batch Inference Models
projects.description: Every model with a :batch id on OpenRouter on 2026-10-31 (71 models), with batch and sync prices, the providers that serve batch, and a price-tier label.

entries.summary: Public projects created on 30 October 2026: 1 repo.
entries.intro: A command-line tool for spoken-word audio applies silence and filler-word removal, pause shortening, and voice-fitted equalization to reach a target loudness. The work sits in podcast post-production and audio processing.

projects.name: Podcast Light Edit Chain
projects.description: One-command light edit for spoken-word recordings: cut ums with the Uhm frame classifier (no ASR), shorten long pauses, voice-fitted EQ, -16 LUFS. With a measured demo.

entries.summary: Public projects created on 29 October 2026: 2 repos, 1 dataset and 3 models.
entries.intro: New repositories covered voice-data preparation and rclone administration, with a tool that trims clicks from training recordings and agent skills for remotes, mounts and config backup. On Hugging Face, the work was wake-word and dictation cleanup: two "Hey Yossi" models, a fine-tune that edits raw dictation, and a reference dataset.

projects.name: Keyclick Detector
projects.description: Detects keyboard and mouse clicks at the start and end of voice-training recordings so they can be trimmed. Trained on real recorder takes.

projects.name: Rclone Manager
projects.description: Agent skills for routine rclone admin: install, remotes, mounts, config backup and migration, docs lookup

projects.name: ASR Cleanup Before After
projects.description: No description published.

projects.name: Hey Yossi microWakeWord
projects.description: A custom "Hey Yossi" wake word for microWakeWord, trained 2026-10-29. It is a streaming, int8-quantised TFLite model of 61 KB.

projects.name: Hey Yossi openWakeWord
projects.description: A custom "Hey Yossi" wake word for openWakeWord, trained 2026-10-29 for a personal voice assistant.

projects.name: S1 ASR Cleanup
projects.description: S1-ASR-Cleanup is a fine-tune of S1-mini by Superwhisper (superwhisper/s1-mini, Qwen3-0.6B) that cleans raw speech-to-text dictation the way one user edits his own.

entries.summary: Public projects created on 28 October 2026: 2 repos and 3 datasets.
entries.intro: New repositories covered agent tooling and image-model evaluation, with a plugin for documenting and analysing home noise pollution and a periodic check of whether image models can produce stylised tech diagrams with correct text and arrows. On Hugging Face, the new work was evaluation material for that graphics benchmark: its test prompts, every generated image, and the raw human ratings.

projects.name: Noise Pollution Analysis
projects.description: Agent skills to document home noise pollution and analyse recordings at the frequency level: hums, tones, low-frequency drone, cycling.

projects.name: Tech Graphics Benchmark
projects.description: Lightweight periodic check: can image models make colourful, stylised tech diagrams with exact text and correct arrows? Text-to-image and image-to-image.

projects.name: Tech Graphics Benchmark
projects.description: Test prompts for Tech-Graphics-Benchmark: can an image model make a characterful banner or a restyled diagram for a tech repo or blog post without getting the text or the arrows wrong?

projects.name: Tech Graphics Benchmark Ratings
projects.description: Raw human evaluation data for Tech-Graphics-Benchmark: one JSON file per annotated generation, written by the annotation Space.

projects.name: Tech Graphics Benchmark Runs
projects.description: Every image generated for Tech-Graphics-Benchmark, one folder per round.
